notes: Planet data cards (owner spec §7 + master plan Phase 10). Fields match the owner's example card: Gravity, Temperature, Atmosphere, Surface Type, Resources, Exploration Status. gravity_ms2 and temperature ranges are SIMULATION INPUTS (jump physics, weather, suit requirements), not display text (master plan Part C #16). landing_allowed / base_building mark Phase 10 scope honestly: planets start as exploration sites reached by transition sequences, never seamless ground-to-orbit flight.

planets.description: The home world: Rupsha City and Nexora Central. All Phases 1-9 content lives here.
planets.name: Nexora Prime

planets.description: The red desert world of the owner's spec: first off-world landing target in Phase 10, with a small research base as the v1 buildable.
planets.name: Nexora-7
planets.surface_type: Red desert, rock fields, canyon systems, polar ice caps

planets.description: Airless moon of the ringed giant: low-gravity base site and the Phase 10 space-station counterpart on a surface. Orbital views of the rings are its signature sight.
planets.name: Kallisto (moon of Nexora-9)
planets.surface_type: Cratered rock and dust plains, shadowed polar craters

planets.atmosphere: Hydrogen-helium, crushing pressure — NO surface landing
planets.description: The ringed giant of the owner's spec. Not landable — ever, by physics. Explored via its moon (Kallisto) and orbital station views; the planet card exists because players will click it in the universe map and deserve a true answer.
planets.gravity_note: Cloud-top reference gravity; there is no solid surface to stand on.
planets.name: Nexora-9
planets.surface_type: Gas giant — banded clouds, no solid surface

planets.description: Earth-like system's moon analogue for Prime: destination of the first crewed flight milestone inside Phase 10's station content; surface visits are a later expansion, so v1 is orbit + info card only.
planets.landing_note: Orbit only in Phase 10 v1; surface landing is a post-Phase-10 expansion decision.
planets.name: Prime Moon
planets.surface_type: Cratered highlands and dark basalt plains

star.description: The system sun (owner spec §7): drives day-night on Prime and the universe-map view with orbital animation + time-speed controls.
star.name: Nexora (star)
